title: Automix transition plan
description: What the planner decides for one transition (src/automix/automix.js plan() and planLoopMix()). Times are seconds of each song's own timeline; 'out' is the playing song, 'in' the next one. The golden files in spec/automix/golden hold one of these per engine version.

pos.description: Playhead of the outgoing song when the plan was made.

earliest.description: Earliest mix-out: pos + the hand-over lead (4 s) + 0.5 s.

plays.description: What the player plays: the loop mix when it found bars on both sides, else blend.style. Its curves are loop.curves or blend.curves.

points.description: [[t, value], ...], t ascending, seconds from the transition's start (may be negative: the outgoing song's speed-up before a blend). Held before the first point and after the last; linear between points, except Hz curves, which move geometrically; a step is two points at the same t.

deckCurves.description: One song's moves. An absent curve stays neutral: lowpassHz 20000, highpassHz 20, bassDb 0, midDb 0, highDb 0, noise 0, sends 0, rate 1.

gain.description: Fader, 0..1 (on top of the song's own volume and levelling).

noise.description: White noise through a 1.5 kHz high-pass, 0..1 (editor.md §12).

echoSend.description: The deck's send to the echo return, 0..1 (editor.md §12).

reverbSend.description: The deck's send to the reverb return, 0..1 (editor.md §12).

delaySend.description: The deck's send to the delay return, 0..1 (editor.md §12).

rate.description: Playback rate (tempo and pitch together, or time-stretched on a stretch deck).

curves.description: What each song does over the transition, emitted by the planner and played by the engine (automix.js blendCurves / loopCurves). The overview draws these, so both apps draw the same thing whatever the engine version. 'out' is the playing song, 'in' the next one.

loopBeats.description: editor.md §13: the Looping lane's length in beats (with a Looping lane only)

fxTime.description: editor.md §12: the echo's and the delay's time, set at the mix's start (with an Effects lane only)

bars.description: Loop length; 4 is tried first, then 2, then 1.

vocal.description: Share of the loop that is sung (must stay under 0.03, no sung run over 0.2 s).

checkedBy.description: Sung spans from synced lyrics, or the open-unmix mask when the song has none.

loopPlan.description: The loop mix. null: no usable grid or a music video. {none}: a side has no instrumental bars.

fold.description: Tempo fold (0.5, 1 or 2) so the ramp is the shortest between the two BPMs.

enterBars.description: Bars the incoming loop plays in, bass cut, at the outgoing tempo.

rampBars.description: Bars of the master tempo ramp (at most 2.5 BPM per bar).

curves.description: t = 0 is the outgoing loop's start.

style.description: blend: beatmatched EQ blend. filter: incoming at its own tempo, low-passed, outgoing high-passed. crossfade: 12 s equal-power fade, the fallback; with handoff, Automix v2's short fade at the natural boundary.

reason.description: Why a filter mix or crossfade was chosen instead of a blend.

clash.description: Share of the blend where both songs sing (version 2).

rerouted.description: Version 2: how the blend point moved to sing less over each other, or why it could not.

vocalsBy.description: What the clash was measured with.

handoff.description: Automix v2 (version 3), "beatmatch or do nothing": the pair can't be beatmatched, so the playing song runs to its music end and the next starts from 0 s, with a 1.5 s fade.

bridge.description: Automix v2: a beatless bridge, the playing song's beatless ending under the next one's beatless opening (4-12 s, any tempo; style crossfade).

shape.description: Automix v2's fallback ladder for a beatmatched pair that can't blend. dropin: the next song at full level on its first downbeat, two bars over the playing song's exit. muffle: the playing song closes behind a low-pass while the next fades in before the bass swap.

muffleLead.description: A muffle's fade-in before the bass swap, as a fraction of the blend.

subBassContrast.description: Version 3: |subBassRatio difference| of the two songs; 0.9 or more vetoes any overlap. null: not measured.

swapAt.description: Version 3: the bass swap's bar line as a fraction of the blend (default: the bar nearest the middle).

swapMoved.description: Version 3: why the bass swap left the middle bar (the playing song sings there), or why it could not.

harmonic.description: Version 3: the key score (keyScore 0.7, chromaScore 0.3), its confidence, severeClash (under 0.2: no blend) and short (under 0.55: a short blend).

trim.description: Version 3: loudness trim. diffDb: the playing region's R128 loudness against its song minus the next region's against its song. outDb: the playing song's gain reached by the end; inDb: the next song's gain at the start, back to 0 by the end (smoothstep). A drop-in's outDb is at least -1.5 (versions.md "The mix's ceiling" rule 6); its diffDb is null when the loudness was not measured. null: not measured.

keyClash.description: 'F major → B minor' when the keys clash and key-aware mixing is on (version 3: always, with the key score: 'F# major → C minor, 0.307'); then the blend is shortened.

curator.description: Automix v2's curator blend (analysis-cases.md "The curator blend"): Auto picked a blend, not the loop mix, and it is placed as Spotify's playlist editors place theirs, 8 bars from the downbeat nearest 31 s before the music ends. Absent: the usual blend.

mixOutTrackTime.description: Outgoing song time where the transition starts.

mixInTrackTime.description: Incoming song time it starts from.

inDelaySec.description: mix-file.md rule 2 [all]: B's late entry, the override's window.in.delaySec, at most durationSec - 0.5. The incoming song stays silent and unstarted for this long after the mix starts, then starts at mixInTrackTime; curves still run from the mix start. Only on a plain blend or crossfade (no shape, glide, hand-over or fallback); absent: B starts with the mix.

rate.description: Incoming playback rate during the blend (with song speeds: speedOut × the outgoing BPM / the incoming BPM, A's played tempo, spotify-mixes.md rule 10; a filter mix or fade: speedIn).

outRate.description: Outgoing rate after the tempo ramp (with song speeds: speedOut, no ramp).

speedOut.description: spotify-mixes.md rule 10: the playing song's playlist speed, the whole time it plays; absent: 1 for both.

speedIn.description: spotify-mixes.md rule 10: the next song's playlist speed, in the mix and after it.

loopSec.description: editor.md §13: the Looping lane, curves.loopBeats of the playing song's beats in its own seconds, looped from mixOutTrackTime.
